SIMPLE PROCESS

In Just 3 Simple Steps

No app to download, no long forms. Just scan — and let AI handle the rest.

01

Scan QR Code

Customers scan the QR code placed at your counter using their phone camera — no extra app needed.

02

Share Experience

A simple page opens — they tap a rating and pick a few tags describing their experience.

03

AI Auto-Posts

Our AI writes a genuine-sounding review based on the tags and rating. One tap and it's posted straight to Google.

Protects You From Negative Reviews

If a customer isn't happy, their feedback comes to you privately — never to Google. You can resolve it personally.

KEY FEATURES

What Makes Review Ninja Pro Different

Keyword-Rich AI Reviews

Our AI doesn't just write generic praise — it weaves in important keywords (Best Food, Great Service) that actively improve your Google ranking.

Multi-Lingual — 100+ Countries

Collect feedback in Hindi, English, Tamil, Bengali or any language. Our AI crafts a natural, polished review in every language.

Zero Friction Posting

Customers never have to type a long review themselves. One tap and the AI-generated review goes live on Google Business.

Smart Dashboard

Real-time insights — total reviews, average rating, keyword performance, negative feedback trends and sentiment analysis to help you improve.
